copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 把 Microsoft Teams 频道接入 NanoClaw:从 channels 分支复制 Teams 适配器、注册、安装固定版本依赖,再构建并跑注册测试;之后引导你用 Teams CLI 建机器人、把凭据写入 .env,并绑定一个负责人。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 加 Microsoft Teams 频道支持时触发。若 .env 里已有 Teams 凭据(任一 key),机器人创建各步骤会整体跳过,直接进入 Restart。

say.text: 把 Microsoft Teams 频道接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册、构建并跑注册测试

say.text: 机器人叫 NanoClaw,公网地址用这个 https://…
say.note: 同一名字用于 Entra 应用、机器人和 Teams 应用

say.text: 把助手绑定到我的 Teams 登录账号
say.note: 确认后助手会主动给这个账号发消息

howto.what_en: Adds Microsoft Teams to NanoClaw: copies the Teams adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned package, builds and runs the registration test. Then guides Teams CLI bot creation, credentials, and wiring an owner.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Microsoft Teams channel support to NanoClaw. If .env already holds a Teams credential, the bot-creation steps are skipped.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams channel support to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, builds and tests

say_en.text: Call the bot NanoClaw, tunnel URL https://…
say_en.note: One name covers the Entra app, bot, and Teams app.

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to my logged-in account
say_en.note: The assistant DMs that Teams user first.
